scope: Qt Widgets Qt5/Qt6 production galleries: 36 buttons; 10 menu actions with hints; all combos, spin boxes, sliders, line/text editors and scrollbars checked for hints. Native delayed hover cycles cover push, combo, integer/decimal spins, horizontal/vertical sliders and one checkable menu action. Dialogs checked. Not every possible layout, full KDE/Kvantum appearance, or historical fidelity.
environment: Two private Xvfb runs and bwrap namespaces, private HOME/D-Bus/Xauthority, no personal home or system bus exposed; no global config, packages, or theme installation.

limits: Both versions use QFusionStyle in this probe; it validates hint behavior, not KDE visual integration.
The run emitted D-Bus portal/inotify resource warnings in isolated namespaces; the guarded probe exited successfully in both versions.
T07 remains partial; other layouts/control-specific timing and manual review are open.
Cold tooltip delay is timed on the push button; subsequent control-specific hovers verify the exact target, geometry, stability, and dismissal during Qt’s active tooltip session.

The Qt gallery now repositions only a native tooltip that intersects its owning widget; if no exterior screen position exists, it hides the tip instead of covering the control. Qt-native palette/style painting remains in use.
Qt5 and Qt6 use QFusionStyle in these private galleries. These checks establish hint behavior and geometry, not KDE/Kvantum appearance or historical DomainOS fidelity.
Cold tooltip delay is timed on the push button; subsequent control-specific hovers verify exact target, geometry, stability and dismissal during Qt’s active tooltip session.

The Qt gallery moves a native tooltip only if it overlaps its owning widget or menu action row; if no exterior screen position exists, it hides the tip rather than obscuring the target. Native Qt palette/style painting is retained.
All 10 QAction entries have hints; timed menu-row hover is proved for one checkable QAction in each major, not every menu action or submenu.
Qt5 and Qt6 use QFusionStyle in these isolated galleries. Evidence covers hint behavior/position only, not KDE/Kvantum fidelity or historical DomainOS appearance.
Only representative hovers were timed across the classes; other layouts and hint-bearing widget types remain open for T07 review.
